Enregistrer les incidents, les classer par ordre de priorité en fonction de leur impact et de leur urgence, et veiller à ce qu'ils soient résolus en temps voulu dans le cadre des accords de niveau de service (SLA) définis. - Assistance aux utilisateurs : Assister les utilisateurs finaux dans l'utilisation, la fonctionnalité et la configuration de l'application SAP. Former les utilisateurs sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités, les flux mis en place, ... PROFIL Votre profil - Minimum 4/5 ans d'expérience SAP Finance et ABAP sur un poste similaire - Bonne connaissance fonctionnelle ainsi qu'opérationnelle de SAP FI/CO (SAP ECC et SAP S/4 Hana) - Bonne maîtrise des concepts et des flux métier logistique - - Vous avez une bonne connaissance des langages et modules spécifiques : ABAP, formulaires (Adobe forms, Smartforms, SAPscripts), enhancement spots, user exit. Une connaissance dans les domaines suivants est apprécié : ABAP OO, BADIs, BAPIs, Web Dynpro, SQL, Web Services, IDOCS, ALE - Compétences en matier/ière de communication avec les utilisateurs finaux - Maitrise du français et de l'anglais indispensable. L'allemand et le Luxembourgeois sont un plus appréciable. Vos qualités - Autonomie, bon relationnel, esprit d'équipe, - Esprit de synthèse et d'analyse, qualité rédactionnelle, - Sens de l'écoute, du conseil et du service client.

Les missions de l'ALVA sont définies dans la loi du 8 septembre portant création et organisation de l'Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire. Lors de la mise en place du gouvernement actuel à la fin de l'année , il avait été décidé de poursuivre la réforme de consolidation entamée par le gouvernement précédent dans le domaine du contrôle de la chaîne alimentaire avec la création de la nouvelle Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA). Dans ce cadre, le gouvernement avait décidé que le Service de surveillance alimentaire (SSA) du Laboratoire national de (LNS), serait transféré vers l'ALVA afin de le fusionner avec le Laboratoire de médecine vétérinaire de l'État (LMVE). Cette fusion, effective depuis le 1er janvier , a donné naissance au laboratoire vétérinaire et alimentaire (LVA), une division de l'ALVA placée sous la tutelle du ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Alimentation et de la Viticulture. Elle constitue la dernier/ière étape visant à centraliser l'ensemble du contrôle de la chaîne alimentaire, couvrant à la fois l'inspection, la surveillance et les analyses de laboratoire, sous l'autorité d'un seul ministère. Missions En tant que Métrologue et Analyste de Données, vous êtes le référent en matier/ière de métrologie au sein du laboratoire vétérinaire et alimentaire. Vous coordonnez l'ensemble des activités métrologiques, veillez à la fiabilité des équipements de mesure en réalisant leur vérification et étalonnage et exploitez les données techniques du laboratoire en collaboration avec les responsables. À ce titre, vous assurez la coordination, la planification et la réalisation des activités de métrologie du laboratoire à Dudelange, en garantissant le bon fonctionnement quotidien et la conformité aux objectifs définis par la direction et le chef de division du laboratoire. Tâches principales: Gestion de la métrologie: Vous gérez l'ensemble des opérations de métrologie des équipements du laboratoire de l'ALVA à Dudelange;  Vous en planifiez les vérifications et étalonnages et pilotez le budget associé. Vous organisez et suivez les vérifications et étalonnages réalisés en interne et par des prestataires externes, évaluez la qualité des fournisseurs, administrez les logiciels de métrologie, notamment Saveris;  Vous animez les réunions métrologie et contribuez à la communication interne et externe du laboratoire;  Vous participez également à l'activité métrologique de l'ALVA à Strassen. Contrôle des équipements et expertise technique: Vous assurez la vérification et l'étalonnage des équipements du laboratoire, tels que les balances, thermomètres, masses de travail, pipettes, dispenseurs et enceintes; Vous proposez des actions d'optimisation et accompagnez les services techniques dans le suivi métrologique de leurs équipements spécifiques. Système qualité et conformité: Vous établissez et maintenez à jour la documentation de métrologie conformément à la norme ISO/IEC :;  Vous réalisez des analyses de risques en métrologie afin de proposer des actions correctives et préventives adaptées; Vous contribuez activement à l'amélioration continue du système qualité, participez aux audits internes et externes, veillez à la conformité réglementaire et participez à la préparation de la revue de direction en collaboration avec le service qualité. Analyse de données: Vous organisez, analysez et exploitez les données du laboratoire en vue de leur utilisation, notamment dans le cadre des dossiers de vérification et des différents rapports; Vous apportez votre expertise méthodologique et statistique, développez, rédigez et évaluez des requêtes, réalisez des analyses critiques, justifiez les résultats obtenus et proposez des pistes d'amélioration. Profil Compétences techniques Vous maîtrisez l'utilisation, la vérification et l'étalonnage des équipements de laboratoire (balances, thermomètres, pipettes, masses de travail, enceintes, etc.) et savez identifier les anomalies ainsi que leurs causes; Vous appliquez et développez les procédures internes; Vous conduisez des projets en assurant leur structuration, leur planification et leur suivi; Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques et les logiciels métiers; À court terme, vous serez capable d'utiliser SharePoint et les outils de gestion électronique des documents; À moyen terme, vous connaîtrez et appliquerez les exigences relatives à la métrologie (ISO/IEC : et normes ISO applicables). Compétences comportementales Développer une vue d'ensemble : Vous développez une vue d'ensemble, vous...

Service de Coordination de la Recherche et de l'Innovation pédagogiques et technologiques (SCRIPT) - En vue de renforcer son équipe, le SCRIPT recherche un coordinateur de projets pédagogiques dans le domaine de l'éducation financier/ière et de l'entrepreneuriat au sein de la Division de Coordination des Initiatives et des Programmes pédagogiques. Cette division développe, coordonne et accompagne des initiatives éducatives innovant/antes visant à soutenir les établissements scolaires et à enrichir les apprentissages des élèves. La personne retenue contribuera activement à la conception, à la coordination, au développement et à la mise en œuvre de projets pédagogiques liés à l'éducation financier/ière et à l'entrepreneuriat ainsi qu'au renforcement des partenariats avec les acteurs institutionnels, scolaires et externes concernés. Elle contribuera également au développement d'outils pédagogiques innovants, à l'évaluation des projets mis en œuvre ainsi qu'à la valorisation et à la diffusion des initiatives en matier/ière d'éducation financier/ière et d'entrepreneuriat. Il s'agit d'un poste combinant des éléments de développement de projets, coordination de partenariats, conception pédagogique et suivi opérationnel. Missions Concevoir, développer et coordonner des projets pédagogiques dans le domaine de l'éducation financier/ière et de l'entrepreneuriat ; Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des concepts, outils et ressources pédagogiques adaptés aux différents publics scolaires ; Assurer le suivi, l'évaluation et l'amélioration continue des projets et activités mis en place ; Développer, coordonner et entretenir les partenariats avec les acteurs institutionnels, éducatifs, associatifs et économiques concernés ; Assurer la coordination avec les établissements scolaires et accompagner la mise en œuvre des projets sur le terrain ; Organiser et animer des groupes de travail, réunions et événements en lien avec les projets coordonnés ; Contribuer à la définition des orientations stratégiques et au développement de nouvelles initiatives pédagogiques ; Assurer la veille et le suivi des évolutions nationales et internationales dans le domaine de l'éducation financier/ière ; Contribuer à la communication, à la valorisation et à la diffusion des projets auprès des différents publics cibles ; Assurer le suivi administratif, budgétaire et opérationnel des projets dont il/elle a la responsabilité. Profil Compétences techniques Bonne connaissance du système éducatif luxembourgeois ; Bonne connaissance des enjeux liés à l'éducation financier/ière, l'entrepreneuriat et à la citoyenneté économique ; Expérience dans la conception, la coordination ou la gestion de projets ; Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ; Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse ; Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et numériques usuels ; Capacité à élaborer des ressources pédagogiques et des supports de communication ; Maîtrise des langues usuelles du pays. Compétences comportementales Gérer les projets : planifier, coordonner et assurer le suivi d'actions et de projets complexes ; Communiquer : adapter sa communication aux différents interlocuteurs et transmettre des messages de manier/ière claire et structurée ; Coopérer : travailler efficacement avec des partenaires internes et externes et favoriser les synergies ; Établir des relations : développer et entretenir un réseau de partenaires dans l'intérêt des projets coordonnés ; Innover : proposer de nouvelles approches et contribuer au développement d'initiatives pédagogiques innovant/antes ; Faire preuve d'ouverture : s'adapter aux évolutions du contexte éducatif et s'intéresser à de nouvelles méthodes et pratiques ; Comprendre l'organisation : gérer les priorités, respecter les délais et assurer un suivi rigoureux des dossiers ; S'impliquer : assumer la responsabilité des projets confiés et contribuer activement à l'atteinte des objectifs de la division. Atouts Expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de l'éducation financier/ière et/ou de l'entrepreneuriat ; Expérience dans le développement de matériel pédagogique ou de programmes éducatifs ; Expérience dans l'animation de groupes de travail ou de réseaux de partenaires ; Connaissance de l'écosystème institutionnel et associatif luxembourgeois ; Expérience dans la gestion de partenariats et de projets interdisciplinaires. title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Description:

Tyvek® is a unique flash-spun nonwoven material renowned for its exceptional combination of lightweight performance,
durability, protection, and versatility. With leading market positions across construction, protective apparel, medical packaging,
and other high-growth industries, Tyvek® continues to shape the future of materials innovation worldwide.
At DuPont, you'll work at the heart of a proprietary technology that combines multiple engineering disciplines, including
chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, polymer science, material science, fluid dynamics, electrostatics, and process
technology.
This is an opportunity to join a company known for its strong safety culture, technological excellence, and commitment to
employee development, while contributing to products that make a real difference in people's lives.
What You'll Do
As a Process Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, innovation, and business growth within our
Tyvek® manufacturing operations.
You will:
• Own and continuously improve manufacturing processes, ensuring the highest standards in process safety, reliability,
quality, and environmental compliance.
• Provide daily technical support to production operations and help optimize line performance.
• Identify, develop, and implement process and technology improvements that enhance productivity, efficiency, and
sustainability.
• Contribute to major capital investment (CAPEX) projects, including process design, engineering calculations, and
technology implementation.
• Lead and participate in Process Hazard Analyses (PHA) and risk management activities.
• Collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges.
• Manage and maintain critical process technology documentation and standards.
• Support the future evolution of Tyvek® technology through innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.
At DuPont, no two days are the same. Your responsibilities and opportunities will evolve as our technologies, products, and
business continue to grow.
What We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, driven engineers who are passionate about technology, problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree preferred in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Bachelor's degree with relevant industrial experience will also be considered.
• Fluent in German and English.
• Strong interest in manufacturing technology, industrial processes, and innovation.
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and develop new technical competencies.
• Self-starter with strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
• Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate across multiple disciplines and functions.
• French and/or Luxembourgish language skills are a plus.

title: Associate professor (promotion track) in Banking Law (m/f)
description:

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

title: CFO HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (m/f)
description:
CFO HSBC Investment Funds (Luxembourg) S.A.

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business.

What you will do:

Reporting functionally to the Asset Management Continental Europe CFO and locally to the CEO of HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL), you will head the Finance function for HIFL, the HIFL Ireland Branch and the HIFL UAE Branch. You will ensure consistently high standards of financial control, reporting and executive insight. You will be a key member of the HIFL Local Management Committee and a standing attendee at key governance forums, presenting the HIFL's financial position to senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Head the Finance function across HIFL Luxembourg, HIFL Ireland Branch and HIFL UAE Branch, setting a high bar for financial control, reporting quality and decision support for executive stakeholders.
• Deliver accurate, timely and compliant Group reporting, producing clear, executive-ready MI and ad hoc insight for stakeholders including the AMEU CFO.
• Own end-to-end statutory reporting: prepare IFRS financial statements aligned to Asset Management standards and maintain strong ledger integrity, including oversight of postings to the HIFL ledger.
• Direct the audit cycle end-to-end, coordinating auditors to meet all deliverables on time and to a high standard.
• Drive a robust balance sheet and cost base: ensure reconciliations are complete and well-evidenced; oversee operational budgets for fund ranges; maintain accurate accruals and invoice governance, keeping forecasts aligned to business changes.
• Provide effective financial stewardship and risk oversight: submit local regulatory returns; validate management fee calculations and intercompany payaways to ensure fair revenue allocation across AMG sites; act as TPEM and/or Risk Steward for suppliers where applicable.

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant professional accountancy qualification (e.g., ACA / ACCA / CA / CPA or equivalent).
• Strong experience in asset management, financial services, audit and/or private wealth management, with senior accountability for financial control and reporting.
• Deep knowledge of IFRS and financial statement preparation. Knowledge of Lux GAAP and Luxembourg regulatory reporting requirements is an advantage.
• Strong leadership capability, including oversight of offshore/outsourced teams and delivery through a matrix environment.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 116,900 – 140,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

Steels made using innovative processes which use less energy, emit significantly less carbon and reduce costs. Steels that are cleaner, stronger and reusable. Steels for electric vehicles and renewable energy infrastructure that will support societies as they transform through this century. With steel at our core, our inventive people and an entrepreneurial culture at heart, we will support the world in making that change. This is what we believe it takes to be the steel company of the future.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and environment we live in.
The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is dedicated to advancing health and improving quality of life through excellence in research, education, and clinical engagement. Responsive to national health priorities and connected to international networks, our researchers address major challenges in human health - from fundamental discoveries to professional practice. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing the training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The successful candidate will contribute to the strategic development and continuous advancement of the University's Medical Specialisation Programmes. The candidate will assist Directors of Studies in developing research ideas, preparing competitive project proposals and funding applications, analysing scientific and educational developments, and translating research outcomes into programme enhancement and innovation. The candidate will work closely with the Directors of Studies, academic and administrative staff, as well as other internal and external institutional stakeholders.
Main responsibilities:
• Support the Directors of Studies in the development, coordination, and continuous improvement of the Medical Specialisation Programmes through research-informed educational initiatives
• Support curriculum development and the implementation of innovative educational approaches, such as simulation, digital learning and artificial intelligence, patient partnership
• Identify national and international funding opportunities and support the preparation of educational research proposals, grant applications, and collaborative project submissions
• Conduct literature reviews, environmental scans, benchmarking studies, and scientific analyses to inform strategic programme development
• Develop and implement programme evaluation strategies, analyse educational outcomes and generate evidence to support continuous quality improvement
• Contribute to scientific publications, reports, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities
• Monitor developments in healthcare, specialist medical training, research funding, healthcare policy, and relevant regulatory frameworks
• Support quality assurance, programme evaluation and accreditation processes of the Medical Specialisation Programmes
• Foster collaboration with national and international academic institutions, healthcare providers, professional organisations, and research networks

Your profile
• Master's degree in Medicine, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Medical Education, Public Health, Healthcare Management, Education, or another relevant discipline
• 5+ years of experience working in medical education, health sciences, clinical research, or a healthcare environment would be a strong asset
• Experience in research project development, grant writing, project coordination, or higher education administration
• Demonstrated ability to prepare research proposals, funding applications, or strategic project documentation
• Strong analytical skills with experience in literature reviews, data analysis, and evidence synthesis
• Excellent scientific writing, reporting, and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate effectively with academic and administrative stakeholders
Language Requirements: Excellent command (C1) of English and French, and very good command (B2) of German or Luxembourgish is an asset.
Diversity and Gender Equality: The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Computer Science (DCS) conducts cutting-edge research and offers high-quality education in core areas of computer science, with particular strengths in artificial intelligence, information security, and advanced computing systems. DCS promotes interdisciplinary research and closely cooperates with other high-profile research centers in Luxembourg and beyond, as well as with industry and society. The faculty entertains various successful and growing teaching programs and supports lifelong learning activities.

Your role
As a professor in the Department of Computer Science, you will:
• Lead research in your area of expertise, with a focus on machine learning and foundation models, and have the opportunity to establish and grow your own research group within a collaborative environment
• Collaborate actively with colleagues across the department, the university, and national research institutions, benefiting from Luxembourg's dynamic and well-funded research ecosystem
• Contribute to teaching at all levels - e.g.: Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral -, designing and delivering courses in your field of expertise
• Supervise and mentor PhD and postdoctoral researchers, and support their development through seminars and related activities
• Participate in shaping the department's research and educational agenda

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Jean-Sébastien Coron, Head of the Department of Computer Science, Email: jean-sebastien.coron@uni.lu


Your profile
The Faculty of Science, Technology, and Medicine (FSTM) seeks a candidate with:
• A PhD degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
• A research track record in Artificial Intelligence, with an emphasis on machine learning and an openness to interdisciplinary collaboration — both within academia and with industry partners
• Expertise in one or more core areas of machine learning and foundation models, such as deep learning, representation learning, probabilistic modeling, reinforcement learning, optimization for learning, trustworthy and efficient machine learning, or foundation models including large language and multimodal models. We particularly value depth of knowledge, originality, and the potential for cross-disciplinary innovation
• Publications in top-tier computer conferences and journals related to AI and machine learning, including but not limited to NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JMLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, IJCV, TPAMI, ACL, EMNLP, KDD, AAAI, IJCAI, ECAI, COLT, UAI, AAMAS, AISTATS, TACL, SIGIR, WSDM, Web Conference
• Experience in teaching Computer Science topics at undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate levels and willingness to contribute to the department's teaching and administrative missions

Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English. Proficiency in French or German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Pascal Bouvry, Dean of the Faculty
• Curriculum Vitae; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)
• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you

title: Senior Sales Director (m/f)
description:
Senior Sales Director

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit a Senior Sales Director to join our global team.

Position Overview:

We are hiring a senior, network-led commercial professional to acquire new logos across the global private markets ecosystem.
While the primary focus will be on top-tier General Partners, this role also spans a broader client base including private credit platforms, real asset managers, venture capital firms, secondaries investors, and fund-of-funds.

This is not a traditional sales role. You will operate as a strategic hunter, leveraging an existing network across private markets to engage both economic and technical buyers including Group Financial Controllers, CFOs, Finance Directors, Heads of Operations, Head of Compliance, Investor Relations and Finance Transformation leaders.
You will play a critical role in shaping how private markets participants across fund managers and adjacent structures, adopt next-generation infrastructure, driving standardisation, efficiency, and liquidity across the ecosystem.
 
Responsibilities 

Proven track record selling into the private market's ecosystem, including but not limited to:  

• General Partners (GPs) across private equity, private credit, real assets, and venture capital  
• Mid-market and emerging managers  
• Secondaries investors and platforms  
• Fund-of-funds and multi-manager platforms  
• Institutional investors (LPs) including pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and asset managers (where relevant to fund operations and infrastructure)  
• Private markets service providers, including fund administrators, custodians, and outsourced finance providers  
Established network across senior stakeholders within private markets, with demonstrable access to decision-makers across both fund managers and the wider ecosystem  

Demonstrated ability to engage and close with:  

• Technical buyers (Fund Operations, Finance Transformation, Middle Office, Fund Accounting, and Systems/Technology stakeholders)  
• Economic buyers (CFO, Group Financial Controller, Finance Director, Operating Partner level)  
• Experience selling complex, high-value solutions such as financial infrastructure, fund administration, data platforms, or fintech solutions into sophisticated financial institutions  
• Strong understanding of how different participants across private markets interact operationally (GP–LP relationships, fund administrators, intermediaries), and where inefficiencies or friction points exist

Commercial Profile

• True “hunter” mentality with a relationship-first approach  
• Established track record in selling to economic buyers across private markets
• Strong commercial judgement and experience structuring enterprise-level deals  
• Ability to position solutions at both strategic and operational levels  

Strong understanding of:  

• Private markets fund structures (LP's and GP's)  
• Operational workflows across finance, middle office, and fund administration  
• Demonstrated ability to interpret and communicate financial and operational value propositions to senior stakeholders  
• High level of commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to engage in value-based and ROI-driven discussions

Personal Attributes

• Highly credible with senior finance stakeholders  
• Strong presence and ability to operate as a peer to client leadership  
• Naturally network-driven with a reputation in the market  
• Intellectually curious with a strong understanding of private markets structures and workflows

Compensation:

• Industry leading base salary - EUR 150,000 - 200,000 depending on experience
• 10% commissions on all sales, payable in monthly instalments, starting month 1 from deal completion
 
Qualifications:  

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (preferred but not essential with relevant experience)  
• Advanced qualifications such as ACA / ACCA / CFA / MBA are advantageous, particularly for credibility with senior finance stakeholders  
 
Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. title: JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
SD-26130-JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING
Fixed term contract | Belval | 12 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

As a Junior R&T Engineer in the NETCOM group, you will contribute to cutting-edge research on wireless network architectures and distributed communication systems, with applications spanning aerial and space platforms. Under the supervision of experienced researchers and engineers, your main responsibilities will include:
• Network architecture design: Contribute to the definition and modelling of communication network architectures for multi-node distributed systems, including the specification of inter-node link technologies, bandwidth and latency requirements, and Quality of Service (QoS) classes.
• Protocol development: Assist in the design and implementation of cross-layer communication protocols, covering message prioritization, timing constraints, synchronization logic, and fault-tolerant fallback mechanisms for degraded link conditions.
• System integration: Support the definition of data formats and interface specifications required for the integration of communication layers with onboard sensing, processing, and command chain components.
• Simulation and performance evaluation: Develop and run simulation models to evaluate network performance under realistic operational conditions, contributing to the validation and benchmarking of proposed architectural solutions.
• Prototyping and testing: Assist in the implementation and laboratory testing of communication modules, including SDR-based platforms and protocol stacks, contributing to the validation of prototypes in controlled environments.
• Documentation and reporting: Contribute to the drafting of technical deliverables, scientific publications, and presentations at project meetings or conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

• Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Studies covering one or more of the following topics: wireless communication systems and protocols, network architecture and design, distributed systems, artificial intelligence, software-defined networking, or embedded systems.

Experience and skills

• 0 to 2 years of relevant professional or research experience (including internships and Master's thesis work) in wireless networks, communication protocol design, or distributed time-sensitive systems.
• Good understanding of network architecture design principles, including protocol stack design, Quality of Service (QoS), and link management.
• Familiarity with inter-node communication and coordination protocols for distributed or multi-agent systems.
• Knowledge of wireless communication technologies and standards.
• Programming skills in Python, C/C++, or MATLAB for simulation, performance evaluation, and protocol implementation.
• Familiarity with network simulation tools (e.g., ns-3, OMNET++, or equivalent).
• Ability to work under supervision while progressively developing autonomy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to interpret results and formulate conclusions.
• Collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a multidisciplinary and international consortium environment.

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas

• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce

• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.

Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

Due to the requirements of the project, we can only consider applications from nationals of a NATO Member Country, from an EU EEA/EFTA Country or from one of the following NATO Indo-Pacific Partners, Australia, Japan, Republic of South Korea and New Zealand.

employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belval | Up to 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

Refrigeration and air conditioning account for ~17% of global energy consumption, a figure expected to triple by 2050, while contributing over 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Conventional vapor-compression cooling relies on high–global-warming-potential refrigerants, creating an urgent need for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly alternatives. Electrocaloric cooling is a promising solid-state technology that can be up to 20% more efficient than vapor-compression systems. It uses ferroelectric materials that undergo a reversible temperature change under an applied electric field. The materials heats upon application and cools upon removal of an electric field. LIST has been working on the topic for some years, specifically developing electrocaloric prototypes based on ceramics and polymers. LIST is recognized as one of the leading institutes in the field.

The role played by materials thermal conductivity on the behaviour of electrocaloric coolers is central to enable a proper understanding of the system. Therefore, this post doc is about studying the thermal conductivity of electrocaloric materials in the context of cooling devices. More specifically, one part will be devoted to the design and fabrication of heat exchangers integrated in electrocaloric coolers. The impact of materials and their thickness will be assessed in specific devices. Another part of this post doc will be devoted to the study of heat switches associated with electrocaloric materials, enabling the design of fluid-free cooling devices.

Other tasks include:

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), the University's main library, supports students, researchers, staff and the wider public by providing documentary collections, information services and expertise that contribute to learning, teaching, and research.

Your role
The role will focus on ensuring continuity of services, maintaining collection quality and supporting ongoing academic needs.
• Act as a key contact / interface between the libraries and University stakeholders, including faculty, researchers, students and administrative departments, in particular within the Faculty of Law, Economics & Finance (FDEF)
• Take ownership of collection plans and budgets for the relevant subject areas,  ensuring expertise and added value to faculty
• Contribute actively to the preparation, update and implementation of collection development strategies, acquisition plans and related documentation, and contribute to defining and adapting practices, tools and approaches based on needs
• Provide expert advice, research support and information literacy training tailored to the needs of students, researchers and teaching staff, and act as a sparring partner for academic users
• Reply to enquiries and support users in identifying, accessing and using relevant documentary resources, databases and information tools, providing added value guidance and expert advice where needed
• Create and maintain subject guides, web pages, bibliographies, thematic selections, tutorials and other user support material, aligned with the specific needs and priorities of FDEF and related disciplines
• Monitor trends in teaching, learning and research in the relevant disciplines in order to keep collections and services up to date, analyse needs and propose improvements and adapted approaches
• Maintain regular interaction with academic stakeholders to identify evolving curriculum needs, new programmes, research priorities and resource requirements, and translate these into concrete collection and service developments
• Promote the libraries' collections, resources and services through targeted communication, outreach, training and advocacy activities that emphasise added value to faculty and researchers
• Analyse usage data and user feedback to support evidence based decisions, prioritise activities based on needs and timeframe, and drive continuous improvement of collections and services
• Contribute to shaping and improving practices for cataloguing, classification, signage, collection maintenance and the organisation of documentary resources according to applicable standards

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent by work experience in Library, Information or Documentation Science; or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline complemented by training or experience in information management
• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an academic or research library
• Strong experience in collection development, user support, reference services, information literacy and communication with academic users
• Good knowledge of library management systems, discovery tools, catalogues, databases and digital information resources
• Experience with collection development policies, acquisition workflows, budget monitoring, usage analysis and service improvement
• Ability to define, apply and improve standards, procedures, methods and tools related to library services and collection management
• Advanced digital literacy and good command of MS Office and professional library tools. Knowledge of Alma would be an advantage

Language Requirements: Excellent command of English and French (C1); very good command of German and/or Luxembourgish (B2) would be considered an asset.

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities

• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

title: Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about marketing, we’d love for you to join our team as a Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager is responsible for the set-up, management, optimization and analyzing performance campaigns in specific regions.

Accountabilities:

    Campaign Optimization & Innovation: Lead the ongoing optimization of media campaigns, utilizing data-driven insights to refine strategies and identify new growth opportunities. Actively test and innovate to ensure sustained campaign performance across digital channels.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal teams (Affiliates, Design and Content) to ensure the integration of marketing efforts. Leverage cross-departmental insights to achieve optimal campaign performance.
    Data-Driven Performance Analysis: Oversee the setup, tracking, and detailed performance analysis of all campaigns using Adservers and other tools. Continuously monitor KPIs, analyzing results against set targets, and providing actionable recommendations to senior management.
    Team Collaboration: Foster a high-performance culture within the marketing team. Serve as a key advisor in marketing tech discussions and proactively improve data collection and performance.
    Creative collaboration: Work on developing design briefs for performance, on the managed campaigns. Work closely with agencies and internal teams to ensure that all creative work meets the highest standards and is aligned with market goals.
    Budget & Spend Management: Monitoring of campaign budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources and staying within agreed financial parameters. Provide regular reports on spend and ROI to senior leadership.
    Rapid Market Adaptation: Demonstrate the ability to adapt to market changes and new opportunities quickly, maintaining flexibility and agility in a fast-paced environment. Ensure that marketing initiatives are always aligned with the latest industry trends.
    Stakeholder Reporting & Communication: Provide regular, comprehensive reports to senior management, highlighting campaign performance, market insights, and potential areas for growth. Deliver actionable recommendations and ensure transparency in performance metrics.
    Any other task/responsibility which may be related and/or connected to the role of Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills:

    Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a media management role within the iGaming industry.
    Marketing degree or marketing post graduate certification.
    Fluent in both written and spoken English with knowledge in another language considered an advantage
    Experience in working on performance marketing campaigns (Programmatic, Fixed CPM, PPC, and Social media).
    Prior exposure to an Adsever tool and on different creative formats.
    Preferably with experience in data collecting scripts, conversion APIs and Google Tag Manager solely related to digital campaigns
    Confident communicator with excellent people skills.
    Project management skills
    Excellent problem-solving skills
    Ability to work as part of a team and on own initiative
    Enthusiastic with a can-do attitude and can work comfortable under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.
    Flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment
    Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially using Excel

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Our Recruitment Process

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: NVVE zoekt een ervaren ICT Medewerker
description:
We zoeken een ervaren ICT Medewerker die graag samenwerkt, makkelijk schakelt en energie krijgt van variatie in het werk. Je vindt het belangrijk om problemen echt te doorgronden en niet alleen op te lossen wat je aan de oppervlakte ziet. Je hebt een relevante ICT-opleiding gevolgd en een aantal jaren ervaring in het vak.
Je past goed bij ons als je
- HBO werk- en denkniveau hebt (ICT, informatiemanagement of vergelijkbaar)
- Een Microsoft 365 specialist bent (met bij voorkeur kennis van Dynamics 365 en Customer Insights)
- Ervaring hebt met het bouwen van agents en andere AI toepassingen
- Ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer en support
- Affiniteit hebt met data-analyse en security
- Nieuwsgierig bent en graag dingen verbetert
- Makkelijk schakelt met collega's die minder technisch zijn

De Nederlandse Vereniging voor een Vrijwillig Levenseinde (NVVE) vindt dat mensen, als het kan, zelf moeten kunnen kiezen wanneer, waar en hoe ze willen overlijden. De NVVE is aan de hand van drie rollen te typeren: Als raadgever geven we informatie en advies aan onze leden en ook aan anderen; we leggen uit wat er mogelijk is volgens de wet en helpen mensen om goed na te denken over het einde van hun leven. Als aanjager gaan we actief het gesprek aan in de samenleving over dit onderwerp; we waken over de huidige verworvenheden en zetten ons in om de mogelijkheden voor een waardig zelfgekozen levenseinde te verruimen. Met 176.000 leden zijn wij een grote vereniging; als aanvoerder brengen we mensen en ideeën samen, zodat iedereen goede keuzes kan maken over het levenseinde. Op ons kantoor in Amsterdam werken ongeveer 40 mensen. Daarnaast geven zo'n 140 vrijwilligers in het hele land voorlichting en advies.
Ben je enthousiast geworden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Stuur je CV en motivatie uiterlijk 31 juli 2026 naar sollicitatie@nvve.nl. De eerste gesprekken zullen plaatsvinden op dinsdag 11 augustus en eventuele vervolggesprekken op woensdag 19 augustus 2026. Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen met:
Bernadette Wiegers, HR Adviseur, bereikbaar via sollicitatie@nvve.nl of 020-5315917.

title: Supportmedewerker
description:
Verdien tot € 20,- per uur als Supportmedewerker in Utrecht
Zoek jij een goedbetaalde baan? Word Supportmedewerker in Utrecht, verdien € 17,- tot € 20,- per uur en pak mooie extra's mee!
Wat ga je doen?
Als Supportmedewerker in Utrecht ben jij de centrale spil tussen de winkels en het hoofdkantoor van een grote landelijke supermarktketen. Je duikt in de logistieke en commerciële processen en bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij dagelijkse uitdagingen. Hiermee bouw je aan een ijzersterke basis op kantoor én verdien je direct een zeer aantrekkelijk salaris.
Je ondersteunt de winkels en verwerkt meldingen vlot via mail en telefoon.
Dagelijks ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor ondernemers en winkelmedewerkers bij uiteenlopende vragen. Je analyseert binnengekomen meldingen, koppelt deze direct aan de juiste procedures en schakelt met specialisten op het hoofdkantoor om complexere winkelproblemen op te lossen. Verder houd je kwaliteitsrapportages nauwkeurig bij in de database en informeer je winkels proactief over wijzigingen in lopende acties.

description:

title: Logistiek Medewerker bij Proforto
description:
Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken en voelt je verantwoordelijk.
Je bent minimaal 32 - 40 uur beschikbaar per week.
Je werkt in een dagdienst van 8.00 - 17.00 uur waarbij minimaal 1x per week in de avond (uiterlijk 23:30 uur).
Je beschikt over MBO werk- en denkniveau.

Hey aanpakker! Ben jij super snel in het inpakken van pakketten, verwerken van retouren of een van de andere diverse werkzaamheden? Wil je deel uitmaken van een hecht en enthousiast team en dit allemaal bij een van de snelst groeiende webshops van Nederland? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als logistiek medewerker heb je een diverse functie en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het gehele logistieke proces. Binnen no-time leer jij alle ins en outs van onze processen met betrekking tot crossdocking, warehousing, retourverwerking en software. Je gaat altijd een stapje verder samen met jouw collega's en met een beetje geluk mag je de radiozender voor die dag uitkiezen.

Wat bieden wij jou?
- Een startsalaris van EUR 2.719,57 bruto per maand.
- 29 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling.
- Een leuk team met enthousiaste collega's.
- Friet op vrijdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en leuke bedrijfsfeestjes.
- Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Groeit Proforto, dan groei jij mee.

title: Lasser MIG/MAG
description:
Leg jij een las die blijft zitten of wil je dit leren? Als Lasser bij T-Pion werk je aan diverse metalen onderdelen waar kwaliteit en nauwkeurigheid niet onderhandelbaar zijn.

T-Pion is sinds 2004 een technisch detacheringsbureau gespecialiseerd in machinebouw, industrie en engineering. Onze T-Pioniers zijn bij ons in dienst, niet bij de opdrachtgever. Dat betekent: een vast aanspreekpunt, begeleiding en een vangnet als een project afloopt.

Wij kiezen voor jou en wij vragen jou hetzelfde. Als T-Pionier ben je geen ingehuurde kracht, je bent onderdeel van ons team. Met alles wat daarbij hoort: betrokkenheid, verantwoordelijkheid en trots op wat je doet.

title: Voorman montage
description:
Voor een van onze relaties zijn we op zoek naar 2 voormannen in de montage buitendienst. Het bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van constructies van staal en glas.
Je werkzaamheden zijn:
- Je zorgt er voor dat het aan jouw toegewezen project in de uitvoeringsfase gesmeerd loopt. Jij werkt mee in het montageteam en bent de link tussen project coordinatie en uitvoering. Jij bent een uitstekende verbinder.
- Je weet precies wat er op de bouw gebeurd en borg je de operationele uitvoering. Ook weet je de uitdagingen van de bouwlocatie en bouwwijze op de juiste wijze te beheersen en vertalen noodzakelijke planning, materiaal en materieel.
- Je zorgt dat de aangedragen planning gerealiseerd wordt. Je signaleert kansen en bedreigingen en zorgt proactief voor adequate acties en aanpassingen.
- Je communiceert met de project coordinatie, de diverse montage partijen en de vertegenwoordiger van de klant. Hierdoor speel je in op de actualiteiten van het project en stem je met alle nodige partijen af.
- Je borgt alle procedures en zorgt ervoor dat alle veiligheidsnormen gehandhaafd worden.

Voor onze andere vacatures kijk ook even op www.werkenvoorhmb.nl

title: Wordt jij onze Topschilder!
description:
Ben jij een ervaren schilder of juist iemand die zijn vaardigheden verder wil ontwikkelen? Bij Succes! Uitzendbureau zijn we op zoek naar gemotiveerde schilders voor uiteenlopende projecten in nieuwbouw, renovatie en onderhoud!

Wat ga je doen?
Als schilder ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het strak en netjes afwerken van allerlei oppervlakken. Je werkt aan diverse projecten, zowel binnen als buiten, waarbij je zorgt voor een professioneel eindresultaat.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

Voorbereiden van ondergronden door schuren, schoonmaken en plamuren.
Aanbrengen van grondlagen, primers en verf op muren, plafonds en houtwerk.
Lakken en vernissen van deuren, kozijnen en andere houtoppervlakken.
Eventueel behangen en uitvoeren van klein onderhoud aan bestaande verflagen.
Adviseren van klanten over kleurkeuzes en afwerkingen.
Werken volgens de geldende veiligheidsrichtlijnen.
Wat vragen wij?
Ervaring als schilder is een plus, maar starters zijn ook welkom.
Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken.
Je hebt oog voor detail en streeft naar kwaliteit.
In het bezit van een VCA-certificaat of bereidheid om deze te behalen.
Rijbewijs B is een pré.
Wat bieden wij?
Een uitdagende baan met afwisselende projecten.
Een goed salaris conform de cao Bouw & Infra.
Uitzicht op langdurige opdrachten of vaste aanstellingen.
Mogelijkheden tot het volgen van trainingen en cursussen (zoals VCA).
Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals reiskostenvergoeding en werkkleding.
Ben jij de schilder die wij zoeken en wil je deel uitmaken van ons enthousiaste team? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en bouw mee aan mooie projecten met Succes! Uitzendbureau!

Succes! Uitzendbureau bemiddelt bouw, technisch en logistiek personeel bij diverse werkgevers in de bouw, afbouw, infra, techniek, transport-, warehousing en distributie. Als specialistisch uitzendbureau zorgen wij ervoor dat vraag en aanbod van personeel in de bouw, techniek en logistiek perfect op elkaar worden afgestemd. Dankzij onze technische, logistieke en bouw-ervaring weten wij uitzenden, detachering, werving & selectie goed met elkaar te combineren. Daarmee voegen wij waarde toe aan de arbeidsmarkt en creëren we de perfecte match tussen mens en bedrijf.

title: Cleanroom monteur
description:
In een supermoderne cleanroom bouw je mee aan hightech modules voor een toeleverancier die werkzaam is voor de chipindustrie. Je gaat volgens technische tekeningen, instructies en specificaties de modules nauwkeurig monteren. Je monteert  mechatronische componenten, elektronica of mechanische (sub)modules. Je controleert regelmatig of alles binnen de toleranties valt want elk detail maakt het verschil. Je voert kleine correcties uit en pleegt overleg met collegas om processen te verbeteren en optimale resultaten te behalen.

Samen met ons team ondersteunen wij externe opdrachtgevers op het gebied van flexibel personeel en recruitment support. Wij werken op projectbasis (tijdelijke inleen), maar ook op basis van detachering met de mogelijkheid tot overname. We zijn alleen werkzaam in de Machinebouw.

title: Monteur brandpreventie
description:
Wij zoeken iemand die ervaring heeft in de bouw. Iemand die handig is.

Vanwege toenemende opdrachten zijn wij op zoek naar een monteur brandwerende applicaties.
Wat wij bieden
Bij De Brandmeesters werk je in een inspirerende omgeving waar veiligheid en kwaliteit centraal staan. Wij waarderen initiatief en bieden volop kansen voor persoonlijke groei en professionele ontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen?
*Het plaatsen of vervangen van brandwerende deuren, kozijnen en glas;
*Montage van brandwerende wanden en plafonds, inclusief de bijbehorende materialen;
*Het nauwkeurig lezen en interpreteren van bouwtekeningen om op maat gemaakte brandpreventieoplossingen te ontwikkelen;
*Digitaal documenteren van alle uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en materialen;
*Deelname aan bijscholingscursussen om jouw kennis en vaardigheden in brandpreventie te ontwikkelen.

Klaar om jouw handen uit de mouw te steken? Reageer dan snel.
Sollicitaties ontvangen wij graag via werkenbij@debrandmeesters.nl
Wil je eerst meer informatie neem dan contact op via mail of bel met Petra via 06-34113726
We kijken er naar uit om met jou in contact te komen.

title: Beveiligingsmonteur
description:
Ervaring als beveiligingsmonteur of elektrotechnisch monteur is een plus. Heb je affiniteit met beveiligingstechniek en ben je leergierig? Dan nodigen we je ook uit om te solliciteren.

Ben jij een techneut die verder kijkt dan alleen kabels trekken? Bij Venema Elektrotechniek werk je aan de beveiliging van de meest uiteenlopende en uitdagende locaties in Nederland. Van hoogwaardige camerasystemen en toegangscontrole tot geavanceerde inbraakbeveiliging: jouw werk zorgt ervoor dat bedrijven, overheidsinstellingen en andere kritische organisaties veilig kunnen vertrouwen op hun beveiligingsinstallaties.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je combineert montage met het configureren en testen van slimme beveiligingssystemen en werkt met de nieuwste technieken. Daarbij krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en werk je samen met een betrokken team van vakmensen.

Zoek jij een baan waarin techniek, uitdaging en afwisseling samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Beveiligingsmonteur het verschil te maken bij Venema Elektrotechniek.

title: Zelfstandig operator
description:
Geen ervaring en/of specifieke opleiding vereist enkel de bereidheid om te leren en uzelf verder te ontwikkelen

United AI is met name actief binnen de groene energiesector. Tevens beschikken wij over de United AI Investment Group: een netwerk van zeven ervaren investeerders en ondernemers, ieder met een eigen specialisme en een uitgebreid zakelijk netwerk.

Onze investeringsgroep is betrokken bij uiteenlopende bedrijven, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Vanuit deze ondernemingen ontvangen wij regelmatig interessante vacatures en aanvragen voor professionals in diverse vakgebieden. Daardoor kunnen wij vaak kansen bieden die niet altijd via de gebruikelijke vacaturekanalen beschikbaar zijn.

Om te bekijken welke mogelijkheden het beste bij jou passen, ontvangen wij graag:

- jouw actuele cv;

- of je bij voorkeur in Nederland of internationaal wilt werken;

- werk je graag in Nederland, dan horen we graag in welke regio;

- wil je liever internationaal aan de slag, laat ons dan weten welk land of werelddeel jouw voorkeur heeft.

Heb je juist de ambitie om als zelfstandig ondernemer aan de slag te gaan of werk je al aan een eigen onderneming? Ook dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek. Dankzij ons netwerk en de kennis binnen onze investeringsgroep kunnen we mogelijk meedenken over kansen, samenwerking of ondersteuning.

Spreekt dit je aan? Stuur ons dan jouw cv, aangevuld met een korte toelichting op jouw wensen en ambities. Na ontvangst bekijken wij zorgvuldig welke mogelijkheden aansluiten bij jouw profiel. Je ontvangt binnen één tot twee weken een reactie van ons.

Stuur je gegevens naar: info@united-ai.ai

Wij vernemen graag van je.

title: Technisch Coördinator
description:
Houd jij het overzicht, ook als er verschillende dingen tegelijk spelen? Als Technisch Coördinator bij T-Pion ben jij de schakel tussen klant en team. Je stuurt monteurs aan, bewaakt de planning en zorgt dat projecten lopen zoals ze moeten lopen.



T-Pion is sinds 2003 een technisch detacheringsbureau gespecialiseerd in machinebouw, industrie en engineering. Onze T-Pioniers zijn bij ons in dienst, niet bij de opdrachtgever. Dat betekent: een vast aanspreekpunt, begeleiding en een vangnet als een project afloopt.

Wij kiezen voor jou en wij vragen jou hetzelfde. Als T-Pionier ben je geen ingehuurde kracht, je bent onderdeel van ons team. Met alles wat daarbij hoort: betrokkenheid, verantwoordelijkheid en trots op wat je doet.

description:
Als pijpfitter werk je mee aan de vervaardiging en de inbouw van pijpleidingsystemen aan boord van de jachten die op de werf in aanbouw zijn. Je werkt mee in de disipline pijpfitter van de afdeling Werktuigbouw. Je vervaardigt de pijpleidingen (zagen, hechten, lassen, solderen, persen en laten verven) bouwt het leidingwerk op en monteert het leidingwerk af aan boord van de jachten. title: (Assisterend) Begeleider EVB IJsselbolder
description:
Welkom op de IJsselbolder!

Je zit rustig naast Lisa op de bank. Ze kan niet praten, maar dat hoeft ook niet. Aan haar ogen zie je dat ze geniet. Je legt zacht je hand op haar arm en voelt hoe ze direct ontspant. Dit is zo'n klein, bijzonder moment waar alles om draait op de IJsselbolder: nabijheid die rust geeft, aandacht die veiligheid biedt, en begeleiding die precies aansluit bij wat iemand op dat moment nodig heeft.

Op de IJsselbolder, onze locatie aan de Commissarislaan 35 in Zwolle, wonen (jong)volwassenen met een Ernstige Verstandelijke Beperking in verschillende woonvormen. In de bestaande woningen vormen vertrouwde ritmes en voorspelbaarheid de basis van elke dag. In het nieuwbouwdeel creëren we stap voor stap een rustige en overzichtelijke omgeving die aansluit bij wat cliënten nodig hebben om zich prettig en veilig te voelen.
Welke woning je ook binnenstapt, één ding blijft hetzelfde: jouw aanwezigheid maakt hier echt het verschil.

Je werkt op de IJsselbolder in Zwolle-Zuid. Dit is een mooi, groot terrein waar altijd wat te beleven is. Je bent onderdeel van een warm en betrokken team, je staat er nooit alleen voor. Er is altijd een collega, arts of therapeut dichtbij om mee te sparren of samen naar een situatie te kijken.

Je bent elke dag dicht bij de bewoners. Je kijkt klein: je leest lichaamstaal, merkt subtiele signalen op en voelt aan wat iemand nodig heeft om de dag goed te beginnen of tot rust te komen. Je biedt een veilig en voorspelbaar dagritme, helpt bij de dagelijkse verzorging en bent aanwezig op de dagbesteding waar je samen activiteiten uitvoert. Soms maak je een fijne wandeling of ga je naar de eigen supermarkt op het terrein en op andere dagen doe je mee aan gezellige activiteiten zoals disco of gym.

Je werkt mee op de woning en zorgt voor rust, duidelijkheid en een fijne sfeer. Samen met je collega's stem je voortdurend af wat helpend is voor iedere bewoner, zodat de ondersteuning aansluit bij wat iemand die dag nodig heeft.

title: Werken als grondwerker
description:

Je taken zullen onder andere bestaan uit:

Graven en dichten van sleuven en putten;
Aanleggen van kabels en leidingen;
Plaatsen van straatkolken en afwateringssystemen;
Ondersteunen van machinisten bij het uitvoeren van graafwerkzaamheden;
Voorbereiden en opruimen van de werkplek.
